title: About Me & Self Introductions
description: Constructing self-introduction (Jikoshoukai) sentences: origin, research area, and courtesy closings.
reviewedBy: Kazi Sakib (Founding Mentor, University of Tokyo)

items.explanation: Customary greeting when meeting someone for the first time ('Nice to meet you').

items.prompt: バングラデシュから来ました (Banguradeshu kara kimashita)
items.soundText: バングラデシュから来ました

items.prompt: 私の専門は工学です (Watashi no senmon wa kougaku desu)
items.soundText: わたしのせんもんはこうがくです

items.prompt: どうぞよろしくお願いします (Douzo yoroshiku onegaishimasu)
items.soundText: どうぞよろしくおねがいします
items.explanation: Essential cultural closing of a self-introduction: 'Please treat me favorably / Looking forward to working with you'.
options: Please treat me well / Pleased to meet you
items.correctAnswer: Please treat me well / Pleased to meet you

items.prompt: 日本語を勉強しています (Nihongo o benkyou shite imasu)
items.soundText: にほんごをべんきょうしています
items.explanation: '~te imasu' expresses ongoing progressive action ('am studying').
options: I will study Japanese next year.
